llms.body:
# Farfetch

> Farfetch is a global luxury fashion marketplace connecting shoppers with luxury brands, boutiques and department stores worldwide.

Farfetch is a marketplace. Product availability, pricing, taxes, duties and delivery options can vary by destination and partner. For authoritative shopping, service and policy information, prioritise the pages below.

## Regional note
- [Farfetch US](https://www.farfetch.com/): US homepage and entry point for US-localised shopping journeys.

## Core shopping
- [Womenswear](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/items.aspx): Main womenswear shopping hub.
- [Menswear](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/items.aspx): Main menswear shopping hub.
- [Kidswear](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/kids/items.aspx): Main kids shopping hub.

## Women's shopping
- [Women's new in](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/new-in-this-week-eu-women.aspx): New arrivals surfaced in womenswear navigation.
- [Women's designers](https://www.farfetch.com/designers/women): Women's designer directory.
- [Women's clothing](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/clothing-1/items.aspx): Women's designer clothing.
- [Women's shoes](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/shoes-1/items.aspx): Women's designer shoes.
- [Women's bags](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/bags-purses-1/items.aspx): Women's designer bags.
- [Women's accessories](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/accessories-all-1/items.aspx): Women's designer accessories.
- [Women's jewellery](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/jewellery-1/items.aspx): Women's jewellery.
- [Women's pre-owned](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/pre-owned-1/items.aspx): Women's authenticated pre-owned luxury.
- [Women's sale](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/women/sale/all/items.aspx): Women's sale landing page.

## Men's shopping
- [Men's new in](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/new-in-this-week-eu-men.aspx): New arrivals surfaced in menswear navigation.
- [Men's designers](https://www.farfetch.com/designers/men): Men's designer directory.
- [Men's clothing](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/clothing-2/items.aspx): Men's designer clothing.
- [Men's shoes](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/shoes-2/items.aspx): Men's designer shoes.
- [Men's bags](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/bags-purses-2/items.aspx): Men's designer bags.
- [Men's accessories](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/accessories-all-2/items.aspx): Men's designer accessories.
- [Men's watches](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/watches-4/items.aspx): Men's watches.
- [Men's sale](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/sale/all/items.aspx): Men's sale landing page.

## Women's edits and discovery
- [What to wear to a wedding](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/the-wedding-guest.aspx): Women's wedding guest edit surfaced on page hero.
- [The bridal edit](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/the-bridal-edit-women.aspx): Women's bridal edit surfaced on page.
- [Spice hues](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/women/trend-spice-hues.aspx): Women's trend edit surfaced in trending now.
- [Spring leather](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/women/trend-new-season-leather.aspx): Women's trend edit surfaced in trending now.
- [Most-wanted accessories](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/women/me-must-have-accessories.aspx): Women's accessories edit surfaced in trending now.

## Men's edits and discovery
- [What to wear to a wedding](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/men/wedding-guest-mens.aspx): Men's wedding guest edit surfaced on page hero.
- [How to style stripes](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/men/stripes-for-men.aspx): Men's trend-led edit surfaced on page.
- [Wardrobe staples](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/men/wardrobe-staples-mens.aspx): Men's essentials edit surfaced in trending now.
- [Most-wanted shoes](https://www.farfetch.com/sets/men/trend-shoes-edit.aspx): Men's footwear edit surfaced in trending now.
- [Polo shirts](https://www.farfetch.com/shopping/men/polo-shirts-2/items.aspx): Men's category link surfaced in trending now.


## Regional note
